requirementResults.requirementId: <uuid of the requirement | type: string | eg: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000>
requirementResults.passed: <whether the requirement is passed | type: boolean | eg: true>
requirementResults.feedback: <brief explanation of why it passed or failed | type: string | eg: Document handles all edge cases correctly.>
requirementResults.location: <section or paragraph reference or null if passed | type: string | null | eg: Introduction section, paragraph 2>
requirementResults.suggestion: <suggested fix or null if passed | type: string | null | eg: Consider adding more detail here>
requirementResults.score: <score for this requirement | type: number | eg: 10>
